items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Set for expanded workload again in Week 9
items.text:
With TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 9, Stevenson is set to handle an expanded workload Sunday against the Packers, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Has chance to play Sunday
items.text:
Head coach John Harbaugh said Skattebo (hamstring) didn't practice Friday, but the Giants are "keeping the door open" for the running back to play Sunday at Philadelphia, Ryan Dunleavy of the New York Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Won't play Sunday against Green Bay
items.text:
Henderson (illness) won't play Sunday against the Packers, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Listed as questionable, won't start
items.text:
Watson (concussion) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, but Shedeur Sanders will start even if Watson is active Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Harold Fannin: Will play Sunday
items.text:
Fannin (groin) will play Sunday against the Saints, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
